snippet.title: Hubble Bubble: Official Trailer | 1-4 Player Co-op Game
snippet.description:
HUBBLE BUBBLE is a 1-4 player online co-op game. You and up to three friends take over a lounge on a space station: take orders, prepare everything together and serve the aliens, while customers, gravity and your own friends make it harder.

Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5013160
Instagram & TikTok & X: @paritagames

#hubblebubble #coopgame #indiegame
